about: THE single list of verified player-name aliases. Every name resolver in the repo (reference savers, DDF legs, players.json bake intakes, match_source_snapshot, legacy ESPN pull, layered/Sleeper identity) reads it through pipelines/lib/player_aliases.py; tests/test_player_aliases.py fails if a resolver keeps a private list. An entry says: a source spelling that normalizes (canonical_players.norm_player_name) to the same form as `alias` is the public.players row `player_key`, whose full_name is `full_name`. Add an entry only after checking public.players: exactly one row has that player_key/full_name/position, and no other row's name normalizes to the alias. Exact spellings only; no fuzzy matching. data/inputs/player_identity_map.json alias_to_canonical may hold only mechanical variants (same norm_player_name form), never a curated alias.
